notes.title: Making a Tutorial That Doesn’t Suck
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

[b]What have we been working on?[/b]

This last sprint we built the first version of our tutorial quest. After April's playtest, we realized it was getting really important to properly onboard players, as many playtesters were getting frustrated due to not quite understanding the loop. It's really important for me that the tutorial NOT be a slog, but it's actually quite complex to balance this with proper teaching. Unfortunately for us, Surfpunk's loop and many of its mechanics are a bit unusual for the genre, so we need to fight expectations. Notably, the game is NOT a Roguelike, and it's a challenge to message that when so many indie top-down games are. Especially since I think Surfpunk still appeals to Roguelike players and that's totally ok!

I'm hoping that for most players, they'll just get onboarded by their friends, but we want to support folks who want to pick up the basics at their own pace. Most likely, we will allow the tutorial to be skippable if you just want to jump into an online game with friends. We all know that feeling of wanting to try a new game with your buddies, but then being forced to play through an extended intro. So, yeah, Surfpunk WON'T do that.

🎬 Here's a video presentation on the new tutorial:

[previewyoutube=WWkWnIqaBOY;full][/previewyoutube]

Other than onboarding, we've been doing the usual bug fixes, balancing and general refinements, etc.

We also completely overhauled the results screen to be much clearer and juicier. It even gives you a letter grade so you know how well you did! Although it's not fully functional yet, we're also planning to have "reward badges" so you can boast with your friends about who did best (currently, everyone gets "Ultimate Warrior")!

We're now focusing our attention now [b]on improving performance and adding more things to do in the metagame[/b], notably side-quests you can pick up from NPC's. More on this soon...!

CRUSH 'N RUSH! 🤙
- Eric

notes.title: Weapon Classes Get a Major Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

These last few weeks we've been focused a lot on improving and differentiating weapon classes. It's really important that we deliver a game where each class feels distinctive and has a special role to play on the team. We're also actively adding features that reinforce co-op play, such as the ability to boost fellow players up a cliff.

Beyond that, we've been working on the map and general flow of Quests to ensure you can make more informed choices on where you're going instead of just randomly exploring.

You can take a look at what's new by watching the latest Dev Update:

[previewyoutube=OyzBqgG1Nxw;full][url=https://youtu.be/OyzBqgG1Nxw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/5d58853337a117d1673ff07d584d43ee917b8a98.jpg[/img][/url][/previewyoutube]

[b]April Dev Update[/b]
https://youtu.be/OyzBqgG1Nxw

Many folks have asked if we have a demo or [b]when we'll have a demo[/b]: We're working on having one ready by the end of this year, but again, we don't want to put it out until we feel it perfectly encapsulates the fantasy and vision of the game.

Currently, our art team has been busy on another project so we haven't moved much on the visuals lately, but the artists will be back as early as next month to help us really get things looking wicked cool. I hope to share some fresh concept art with you soon.

I hope you'll look forward to it.

notes.title: Making the Ultimate Co-op Action Game - Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've decided to change the way we do video updates. Going forward there will be:

🔹 [b]Devlogs[/b] where I talk about various higher-level subjects surrounding Surfpunk's development. Our vision, design philosophy, art deep dives, etc. These will be geared to a broader audience with the goal hopefully bringing in new players to discover and Wishlist the game. I will do my best to have one out every month, but they may follow a less structured schedule going forward.

🔹 [b]Dev Updates[/b] where I will talk over fresh gameplay footage and discuss the major features we've focused on in the last month or so. The idea being that these are mainly for the community that is already following Surfpunk's development. I will maintain these once a month.

[previewyoutube=cKEQSDjnuBA;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=ecN4ERvDsWI;full][/previewyoutube]

Previously, I was sort of doing both together with the old Devlogs and thinking of them mainly for the folks in the community. But I'm realizing that the Devlogs have a lot of potential to reach more people who have yet to discover the game. People who stumble on the Devlogs however are likely to have less context to understand specific build updates, so I'm spinning those off into the Dev Update videos.

---

[b]A note on playtests[/b]; we've been conducting smaller-scale playtests with hand-picked groups of volunteers. Why the change? Simply put; we needed to go deeper. Large-scale playtests generate a ton of valuable feedback, but with so many players, it’s challenging to fully analyze everything. By working with smaller, tight-knit groups, we can better understand how friends play, communicate, and experience the game together. That said, larger playtests will return! But from time to time, we may run more selective sessions to help refine key aspects of the game.

If you haven’t played in a while, don’t worry, you’ll have even more to look forward to when you jump back in!

Thank you, once again for your continued support...!

CRUSH 'N RUSH! 🤙

- Eric

notes.title: Surfpunk - November Update - Devlog #1
notes.content:
Whoa, when did it become November already? We know we've been a little radio silent lately, so we wanted to touch base and let you know what we're all up to over here at Double Stallion! We are looking to be more transparent and provide more updates regularly on the development of Surfpunk, so keep your feet firmly planted on those Rushboards - we've got some exciting stuff in store!

Check out the latest updates below and watch the great devlog put together by Eric!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jIiGOjAVME

Check out the video above for all the latest details!

To answer the biggest question on everyone's mind: [b]When is the next playtest happening?[/b]

The truth is: we had to postpone the next playtest. We just don't feel like the build and new mechanics are in quite the right spot for folks to be testing yet. Additionally, we are looking to have more of the metagame ready before you hop in! So while we don't know when the next playtest is going to be exactly, we know that it should be soon. Keep checking our newsletter updates and stay tuned to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/doublestallion]Discord announcements[/url]!

But rest assured, we've got lots of new additions and items we've been working on. Here are some of the big highlights:

[list]
[*] [b]Quest Selection:[/b] We've updated how Quest selection works. Now you can select your difficulty independent from the Quest itself. Also, we have a new island generation algorithm which creates a different style of archipelago.

[*] [b]Anchor and Guitar Weapon Classes:[/b] We've been iterating a lot on these two weapon classes in particular! The Anchor is a heavy-type with high damage output, while the Guitar is a caster-type with abilities that reflect attacks and push back enemies. For those that tried out the Anchor in the last playtest: yes, usability has greatly improved! We are looking forward to your continued feedback!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/fedfb900fe284daebad73a6a386880ee1251d8e1.gif[/img]

A look at the work-in-progress guitar class in action!

[list]
[*] [b]New Islands:[/b] We are building ✨new✨ islands to increase the variety with procedural generation. These new islands aren’t been fully "artified" yet, but they do offer some cool new situations for scavenging.

[*] [b]Raider Customization:[/b] Did somebody say "character creator"? We've recently implemented our first version of the Raider cosmetics customization menu. This was a popular feature highlighted in our surveys, so we prioritized it for you! We’ll be adding more hairstyles and outfits as development continues.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/31f8f7b6cc585680541aff5a8a4ef8978277a118.gif[/img]

A look at the work-in-progress Raider character cosmetics customizer!

That's only a small fraction of the great work our team has been up to, but we hope it gets you excited for more things to come! Thank you so much for your continued support. We'd love to hear from you! Join us in the Discord and socials, and let us know what you think!

CRUSH 'N RUSH!

notes.title: Surfpunk - October Update
notes.content:
Happy October! It's been a busy month at Double Stallion, as we work hard to make Surfpunk as rad as it can be, bruh! But it was about time we gave you an update as to what's going on in the flooded isles - so read on to get informed!

First up, Raiders - our second trailer is live and ready for viewing at your leisure! In this video, Surfpunk's Creative Director, Eric Angelillo, breaks down the gameloop and what you can expect when you play Surfpunk! Without further ado, give it a watch:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6zy3fOrO8o

Whaddya think? As you can see, we definitely have some STELLAR stuff surfin' down the pipeline! 🌊

In fact, you might have noticed a few new features added to the game...

[h2]🚨 WARNING: INCOMING TSUNAMI 🚨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/a4335a8e6d538a6aa87d01b22b937e2465e1b069.gif[/img]
Sick waves, bruh!

After you've finished plundering the Isles for all they're worth, that's when it's time to really put the SURF in Surfpunk! At the end of a run, a giant tsunami will come roaring through the map, and you and your friends will have to make a daring escape while keeping your Rushboards afloat! It's the stuff surf dreams are made of, but make sure you're up to the task - a wipeout is never cool, bruh.

So, you've explored the archipelago, you've completed quests, collected Evress, and are spending your hard earned items crafting and upgrading gear on the Beastship. How does a Raider wind down? Relax? Chill out, y'know? Well, we've got the answer...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/b1017b21d718a5dc7b443f09a0ea3a96a50ba729.gif[/img]

Introducing the...OTTER-RABBIT THING!! Is it an otter? Is it a rabbit? Does it even really matter? It's adorable. And yes, YOU CAN PET IT. 

We don't have too much to say on the little guy right now, but you can bet he will be there to share your journey across the flooded isles as you become the strongest, most powerful Raider. And remember, do not forget, the very most important fact about the Otter-Rabbit Thing:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/8fd617fd56f45a1f169bb29da3ad404ec3f73d18.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/7032c862518aaa09ee001593ff70b245bff82dbe.png[/img][/url]
It's true! You can pet it! Certified pettable!

That's it for us this week! Stay tuned for more details on future playtests. We're always looking for more friendly faces to join us, so please invite your friends, family members, coworkers, otter-rabbit things, or WHOEVER to give us a follow, sign-up for playtests, and give us a Wishlist! :blue_heart:

CRUSH 'N RUSH!
🏄☠️

notes.title: Surfpunk - August Update
notes.content:
Hello Raiders, welcome to the totally tubular Surfpunk update #2! Today’s update is a little on the shorter side but it comes with some AWESOME NEWS! Read on for a super exciting announcement!

But first, we wanted to talk a bit about THE BEASTSHIP! 

[h2]⚓THE BEASTSHIP⚓[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/c6c5498ce99c90801ed38691fd3e3a1a2200d45c.png[/img]

[i]Credit: Virtuos Montreal[/i]

You’ve seen glimpses of the Beastship before but NOW, we wanna properly introduce you to this bodacious boat. And who better to give you the hot details than Eric Angelillo, the creative director of Surfpunk!

[i]“The Beastship is the Raiders’ floating home base. It functions as the player hub between quests, and we conceived it to be an awesome hangout area for players. The ship will house NPCs and various stations for Raiders to interact with, craft gear, and change their loadout. We’ll have some other surprises as well!

Aesthetically, the Beastship is meant to highlight the world of Surfpunk and its level of technology. It’s a patchwork vessel with a triple-hull and various mechanized features powered by Evress, the key energy source that players seek on their scavenging quests. Its bow is a massive beast-looking hangar bay door, which houses and launches Raiders on their Rushboards.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/5f5796e98cced463d05de5282c65535be77a2ec7.png[/img]

[i]Credit: Erika Rhyno[/i]

The Beatship is a BEAST of a SHIP right? A fine name for a fine vessel! Can't wait to get in there and hang with our fellow Raiders and discover all the Beastship has to offer!

[h2]✨AND NOW...AN ANNOUCEMENT!✨[/h2]

We’ve got a date for our first public playtest: 
🌊August 31, 2024 at 1:00 PM EDT! (10:00 AM PDT)!🌊

If you’re reading this, you might be interested in joining! Stellar!
Please [url=https://dblstallion.com/games/surfpunk/?utm_source=steamforum&utm_medium=social#newsletter]sign up for playtests here[/url]!

Please note that only a small portion of raiders will be chosen for this particular playtest.
But fear not, bruh! There will be many more opportunities to play Surfpunk leading up to its eventual release!

Thanks for reading! We’re looking forward to shreddin’ some waves together! 🏄

CRUSH 'N RUSH!
🏄☠️

notes.title: Surfpunk - July Update
notes.content:
It's our first official Surfpunk update! It’s been a couple of weeks since the game was announced and the team has been hard at work building an awesome game that can only be described as TOTALLY TUBULAR (definitely -not- apologizing for the insufferable amount of surf lingo)! We're going to use this space to keep you in the loop on what’s new in the game, fun highlights of game development, and other cool Surfpunk updates!

Let’s check it out!!

[h2]🌊We put waves in our surf game!🌊[/h2]

While Raiders take to the ocean with their trusty jet-powered rush boards, it really wouldn’t feel like a surf game without…waves, right? Sure, we had waves of ENEMIES before, but now we’ve got those sweet ocean swells. And hey, not only are WAVES added (and don’t they look beautiful), but there just might be a more sinister and bigger wave in the works…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/0c295602cbb56a193a97bd75c8deb577e3fbb41d.gif[/img]

How do you like the look of these? It's still a work in progress!

Speaking of sinister…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/43485080ec4e7c283db8a132000c2331a6f73fa0.png[/img]

[h2]Sumi Spotlight[/h2]

While you’re out there collecting Evress and epic loot, you’re gonna encounter the Sumi. They aren’t nice. They are mean, violent, and up to NO good. They are out for blood, and have a particular appetite for the sunkissed, saltwater-seasoned Raiders that haunt their shores. That’s all just a long-winded way to say they are the bad guys. The enemy. And you don’t need to feel bad about crushin’ ‘em. They deserve it.

You may have seen a bunch of Sumi swarming the hapless heroes throughout our debut trailer. But Sumi’s come in many shapes and sizes - check out this awesome CREEP that’s currently in the cooker. This is the new model for our "mortar" enemy that will lob projectiles at the raiders:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/aa162e0a1430b372fec225a133e6e1515ff15374.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/aa162e0a1430b372fec225a133e6e1515ff15374.gif[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/f62c8bb70f0cf37f1602f72ddffdb947777e6661.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/f62c8bb70f0cf37f1602f72ddffdb947777e6661.gif[/img][/url]

Gross. But maaaaybe it’s a little cute? Anyone? No?

To conclude our inaugural udpate, we thought it’d be fun to highlight weird and funny bugs encountered during game development. Let’s enter…

[h2]🐛THE BUG ZONE🐛[/h2]
(title may need to be workshopped 😅)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111848/febeb5621abf063d74e15b80611793957f90275b.gif[/img]

You wanted to pick up the barrel. Now you’ve BECOME the barrel.

[b]One important note before we sign off! [/b]Our first public playtest is planned for the end of August! Be on the lookout for proper dates and announcement coming soon! In the meantime, get your crew together - encourage your friends to sign up and test the game too - the more, the merrier!

Thanks for reading! We'd love your feedback and don't forget that you can always find us on social media and on Discord (linked below)! 

CRUSH 'N RUSH!
